title: Agent's Please?
excerpt: Badges to indicate whether a project allows or disallows AI use.
content_html:
Agents Please?

Some projects allow and desire AI use, some projects explicitly do not want it. We should respect one anothers requests, and make it simple to know which is desired.

Do you use AI in your project?

No Yes
